criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Purdue's 2020 opening article states four stories; the supplied official photo and contractor photo show a broad, shallow flat roof edge. Reopened model height is 16.00 m and cap is modeled at z=16.00 m.
findings: 16 m height and 0.72 m overhang are explicitly estimates; no elevation or survey datum supports them.
Roof is represented as one flat cap; photographed roof soffit supports the general form only.

criteria.evidence: Mesh has 2116 vertices, 517 polygons, and materials ['CHAS - red brick', 'CHAS - dark ground brick', 'CHAS - blue gray glazing', 'CHAS - limestone bands', 'CHAS - wood soffit and roof']. Photos support red brick, blue-gray glazing, dark base, pale horizontal bands, and deep soffit.
findings: Reference photos show broad, nearly continuous curtainwall fields, narrow vertical mullions, solid brick end zones with tall slit windows, and visible doors; the model instead uses repeated isolated rectangular window panels and largely unarticulated brick end walls.
No distinct entrance or canopy geometry is present, and the selected preview omits the principal photographed elevation.
A single extruded GIS polygon cannot demonstrate the actual wing height/setback differences beyond the outline.
